CASE FILE: LX-07
UNIT: LINUX SYSTEMS REVIEW
STATUS: OPEN

A small Linux file server used by the North Pier dispatch team was copied during an equipment audit. The active handover record was missing from the previous examiner's visible directory listing.

The examiner's notes indicate that the handover was stored beneath dispatch/active, inside a dot-prefixed directory, and that the note itself also used a hidden filename.

OBJECTIVE
Extract the workspace archive, locate the hidden handover note under dispatch/active, and recover its recovery marker.

EXHIBIT A — recovered_workspace.zip

TOOLS
Use a Linux shell. The standard commands unzip, cd, ls -a, find and cat are sufficient.

No server connection or Internet access is needed.
